The map clearly shows '@' at (2,7) with all surrounding tiles walkable ('.'). The notice board is NOT drawn as 'o' anywhere near me. So the map says I can move, but the game refuses.

The pathfinder error "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)" is the key clue — the pathfinder's collision map has the notice board at (2,7), the same as my position. So the pathfinder thinks I'm inside a solid.

But the actual movement (raw input) also fails. This means the game's real collision also has the board at (2,7) and I'm inside it.

Hmm, but the map renderer shows '@' there. Perhaps the renderer draws me over the board. 

Let me try: maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm actually at (2,7) but the game considers me "on" it and I need to press E to read it — but E checks the tile I'm *facing*, not my own tile. Since I can't face my own tile, I can never read it.

This looks like a soft-lock. But the task is achievable per the wiki. Let me reconsider: maybe the observe "You: Workshop (2,7)" is stale/wrong and I'm actually elsewhere. The player is at (3,7). Let me try walking to the player's tile (3,7) — adjacent.
